info.name: AQDAR API
info.description:
AQDAR Egypt marketplace REST API (`/api/v1`).

Import `AQDAR-Local.postman_environment.json`, select **AQDAR Local**, then run **Phase 1 — Identity → Register** or **Verify OTP**. `auth_token` is stored automatically.

After each finished phase, add a folder `Phase N — …` with every new route. See docs/DOCUMENTATION_PROCESS.md and docs/API.md.

**Shipped:** Phase 0–9 (identity through admin reports/settings/audit/hardening).
Staff dashboard is Blade (session), not this collection. ADM-10…14 are not in this collection.

item.name: UI closure — 2FA, discovery, tracking, account, recently viewed, media order

request.description: When `POST /auth/login` returns **202** with `two_factor_required: true`, an OTP was sent to the verified phone. Send the `challenge` from that response with the 6-digit code to receive the token. Challenge lives for the OTP TTL and is single-use.

Bearer. Turns two-factor on or off for password logins. Requires a verified phone to enable; `current_password` is required when the account has a password (prohibited otherwise). Response is the user resource (`two_factor_enabled`, `region`).
Bearer. `current_password` required when a password exists; OTP-only accounts set their first password without it. Other sessions are signed out; the current token stays valid.
Bearer. Returns `{date, open, slots:[{value, available}]}` from `AQDAR_VIEWING_SLOTS`. Past slots and closed weekdays are unavailable; booking validates against the same list.
Public. `ids` is 2–3 distinct published listing ids (array or comma-separated). Returned in the requested order with public fields only.
